title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Duo #14 (GeorgianMinonkari+CubistFragment+EthiopianCrossLattice / UkrainianPysanka+HungarianKalocsa+PortugueseAzulejo)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Ukrainian woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, demure and soft, soft pastel-pink hair styled in low bun, real living eyes. Long oval nails, chrome finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel (a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework, wide gold bands, dense cloisonné floral wirework) dominates one zone. Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once, wide silver bands, dense angular fragment planes) dominates the second zone. Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework, wide gold bands, dense lattice linework) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Left woman's footwear: extreme sculptural heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, cool and composed, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glittery finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework (a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands, dense geometric wax-resist linework) dominates one zone. Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals, wide gold bands, dense folk-art floral motifs) dominates the second zone. Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands, dense repeating panel scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: both arms raised overhead.

Center woman's footwear: extreme ballet heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
